gloss_en: "a pure (clear) language" — the phrase שָׂפָה בְרוּרָה from Zephaniah 3:9 ("then I will transform the peoples to a pure language, that they may all call upon the Name of HaShem"), which Rabbi Nachman reads as the future perfection/completeness of speech (shlemut ha-dibbur) attained when all humanity calls upon God, achieved through faith
